Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: AcmeHealth private/VPC discovery + next steps

Hi Tom / Priya - thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have alignment and clear next steps. Please reply/edit if I missed anything.

Summary of pain points
- Must keep PHI on customer-managed infrastructure (data residency + strict controls) - primary driver for Private/VPC or on-prem.
- Network constraints: egress is tightly controlled; only specific outbound endpoints allowed, and anything that requires open outbound streams will need firewall exceptions.
- Air-gap consideration: legal/ops asked about a fully air-gapped option for high-risk workloads.
- KMS/HSM requirements: customer-managed keys and FIPS-validated HSM for encryption at rest.
- Auditability: detailed audit logs, retention controls, and access logging required for audits.

Goals discussed
- Proof-of-concept (PoC) on customer VPC to validate latency and throughput with PHI flows.
- Deliverable checklist for security & network teams (ports, IP ranges, certs, BAA scope).
- Timeline: pilot kickoff target = mid-July, 6-8 week PoC.

What Redwood can offer (high level)
- Private deployment (VPC) with customer-managed networking and optional on-prem bundle for air-gapped installs.
- Support for customer KMS integrations + audit logging and retention controls.
- SOC2 artifacts and a short compliance summary attached; we can surface more during legal review.

Attachments
- redwood-private-deploy-architecture.pdf (high-level network diagram)
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (SOC2 scope and summary)

Immediate next steps
1) Please share your network contact and any firewall change window constraints - we need an infra owner to exchange port/IP requirements.
2) Priya / legal: confirm whether a BAA is required as part of the PoC and any additional legal docs needed.
3) I will follow up with a short private deployment checklist and proposed tech deep-dive times (Jonas will lead the architecture session).

Proposed times for tech deep-dive: Tues 6/16 or Wed 6/17 - are either of those ok?

Thanks - Camila

--
Camila Reyes

Thanks Tom - appreciate the fast turnaround. Fine to loop infra@acmehealth.com and legal; copied Jonas to lead the technical session. Quick responses to your asks below and next actions.

1) Air-gap / on-prem PoC
- Yes, Redwood supports an on-prem air-gapped deployment for an isolated PoC. We provide an on-prem package (installer + runtime) and a small operations playbook for the duration of the PoC.
- Preliminary footprint estimate for a functional PoC: 2x A100-equivalent GPUs (for inference throughput testing), 4 vCPUs per host, 64-128GB RAM, 1TB NVMe for model cache - final sizing depends on model family and expected concurrency. Jonas will validate once we have expected QPS and model choice.

2) BAA & compliance artifacts
- Attaching the SOC2 summary now (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf). We are happy to sign a BAA; legal, please let us know required timelines/clauses.

3) Network checklist and ports
- I've attached a short private deployment checklist (redwood-private-checklist.xlsx) and the architecture diagram. For the VPC option we typically need outbound access to a small set of Redwood control-plane IPs for telemetry/patching, but we can run with a scheduled maintenance/managed-sync pattern for stricter networks - Jonas will detail options.

4) Proposed next steps / owners
- Infra (Tom / infra@acmehealth.com): confirm preferred PoC mode (VPC vs air-gapped) and share change window constraints.
- Legal (legal@acmehealth.com): confirm BAA requirements and timeline.
- Redwood (Camila / Jonas): prepare PoC statement of work + pricing for a 6-8 week PoC; Jonas to run a 60-min tech deep-dive.

Action: Jonas - can you run the deep-dive Tues 6/16 at 10am PT? If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and attach the preliminary SOW.

Thanks - Camila
